cover.concept: A pale rectangular page frame in muted indigo with one small accent-orange tag lifting gently off its surface and floating on a thin thread toward a separate, distant card shape, as if something written for one place is quietly being carried to another.

inline.name: page-offer-source
inline.concept: A flat page frame in muted indigo holding three small tag shapes of equal size; two are dim and faded, one glows accent orange, and a single thin line rises from the glowing tag up toward a floating card, showing that the machine picks whichever tag is readable, not whichever is current.

inline.name: account-switch
inline.concept: A single small toggle switch in accent orange on a calm pale indigo panel, with one thin thread running from it to a floating card shape; the switch sits alone and deliberate, suggesting one setting decides whether an outside system speaks on the owner's behalf.
